dcterms:description: A real-life, French-accented speech corpus of Air Traffic Control (ATC) communications, composed of 59 hours of transcribed English audio, along with linguistic and meta-data annotations, intended for building a robust ATC speech recognition engine.
dcterms:title: AIRBUS-ATC Corpus
